title: Hyrox SkiErg + sled push superset
creator: Greg Williams (Rox Lyfe)
description: Three rounds of 800 m on the SkiErg straight into a 40 m sled push, the way the two stations follow each other in the race. Rox Lyfe suggests adding a run between rounds to make it more race-like. Rest a couple of minutes between rounds if you are not adding the run.

source.title: HYROX Training Plan Fundamentals – Rox Lyfe
source.author: Greg Williams
source.license: Published protocol; description in our own words

steps.note: Or run 500-1000 m instead of resting
